title: Northcliff Electronics — on-prem inference evaluation scratchpad
content:
Context: 11/09 call w/ Northcliff (Claire + Diego). They run automated optical inspection (AOI) and need an on-prem inferencing layer for: real-time anomaly triage on PCB assembly lines, short textual summaries for operators, and embeddings for trend detection across shifts. They emphasized: no cloud egress, 90-day local retention only, and <60ms P99 token latency for short prompts (10-50 tokens).

Current infra at customer: two rack units per site, each with 1x L40S (planned upgrade) + 4 x NVMe nodes, factory network is isolated behind NAT/edge router, intermittent VPN to central office, OPC-UA controllers feed events via local gateway.

Key technical risks / gotchas observed:
- Network: factory NAT + intermittent VPN -> need robust reconnection + offline queueing for telemetry. Consider local Promtail + buffered uploads, or a webhook retry queue.
- TLS/KMS: they insist on HSM-backed key wrap. Ask security: do we support customer KMS via AWS CloudHSM or on-prem PKCS#11 HSM?
- Latency: target 60ms P99. With L40S we can hit ~30–40ms for 512 context if batching disabled, but continuous batching could push P99 > 100ms. Recommend single-request low-latency config + tiny batch windows for predictable SLO.
- Quantization: they plan to run a finetuned 7B variant. Early quantization to int8 causes numeric extraction drift (we saw similar with retail customers). Add eval tests focused on numeric/CSV-like outputs.
- KV cache warmup: many prompts are similar (template+values). Warm cache strategy critical for first-token latency; warm-up after shift-change is a common pain. Suggest prefix caching + lightweight pre-warm job at shift handover.
- Integrations: PLC -> gateway -> NATS -> Redwood runtime adapter. Need lightweight adapter binary for gateway that does retries and signs payloads.
- Observability: customer needs operator-facing metrics in Grafana and token-level cost broken down. We'll map to Prometheus exporters + local retention 180d for metrics (logs still 90d).

Open questions for customer (Claire/Diego):
1) Exact per-site expected QPS during peak (we estimated 40rps from video sample, but need confirmation).
2) Which HSM vendor? Do they have AD integration?
3) Do they accept occasional on-prem maintenance windows where model rolls cause <5m degradations? SRE/customer ops alignment required.
4) Are model weights allowed on air-gapped USB transfer, or must they be pulled from private registry inside VPC?

Action items / next steps:
- Maya: prepare a short L40S perf matrix vs 7B/13B (int8 and fp16) by 11/13. Link to eval harness PR (github above).
- Jonah: sketch gateway adapter prototype (node binary) by 11/18 — include retry backoff and signature header.
- Priya: confirm KMS/HSM integration options with Security (due 11/15).
- Alexei: draft Grafana dashboard templates & Prometheus job configs for local ops (11/17).
- Claire: send anonymized sample payloads (3 minutes of AOI outputs) by 11/12 so we can run representative perf + quantization tests.

Notes to self: keep eval dataset small but representative (include many numeric fields, bounding-box coordinates, and templated prompts). Add a regression check for CSV/JSON output fidelity post-quantization. Avoid recommending heavy batching as default — factory operators prefer predictability over throughput.

Slack refs: #solutions-northcliff, mention @Priya for KMS chat.

Quick checklist for next call (11/20): peak qps, HSM vendor, sample data uploaded, perf matrix ready, gateway prototype demo.

Rough risks (traffic-light):
- Security/HSM integration: amber (depends on vendor APIs).
- Latency SLO at scale: amber->red if they try heavy batching.
- Model fidelity after quantization: amber (needs eval).

End of jot.
